title: Account/session compromise
cause: Environment password staff auth or non-revocable cookies expose sensitive operations.
planned_mitigation: Use accepted OIDC/MFA, revocable server sessions, throttling and recovery/offboarding.
residual_risk: IdP compromise and session theft remain possible; exercise revocation and fresh authentication.
residual_rating: Unverified until control evidence and accountable-owner review

title: Cross-person or branch disclosure
cause: ID guessing or incomplete field/branch checks expose care, HR, payroll or evidence.
planned_mitigation: Deny-by-default relationship/field permissions, scoped FKs/RLS and server-side projections.
residual_risk: Misconfigured memberships or privileged DB roles can bypass intent; review and negative-test all paths.
residual_rating: Unverified until control evidence and accountable-owner review

title: Broad native service credentials
cause: A native key may act with account-owner scope and native attribution cannot identify the actual approver.
planned_mitigation: Use narrow native credentials where supported, application operation allowlists, scoped workers and own actor/approval audit.
residual_risk: Vendor credential scope/attribution limitations remain; native-owner activity needs reconciliation.
residual_rating: Unverified until control evidence and accountable-owner review

title: CSRF and trusted-header confusion
cause: Origin checks or forwarded headers alone can authorize an unsafe browser mutation.
planned_mitigation: CSRF token, explicit origin rules, trusted proxy configuration and secure host cookies.
residual_risk: Browser compromise still defeats same-session protection; use MFA/re-auth and field authorization.
residual_rating: Unverified until control evidence and accountable-owner review

title: Stored XSS and unsafe mail rendering
cause: Mail, notes, templates or filenames execute active content or load tracking resources.
planned_mitigation: Context encoding, safe text/sanitization, CSP and blocked unapproved remote content.
residual_risk: Sanitizer/browser defects remain; patch and regression-test rendering.
residual_rating: Unverified until control evidence and accountable-owner review

title: SSRF through native download links
cause: A signed URL or redirect points at metadata/private networks or an unapproved host.
planned_mitigation: Validate exact destination, protocol, port, DNS/IP ranges and expiry; block redirects and limit bytes/egress.
residual_risk: DNS/storage-provider changes can invalidate allowlists; fail closed and review changes.
residual_rating: Unverified until control evidence and accountable-owner review

title: Malicious evidence or OCR exhaustion
cause: Files exploit parsers or exhaust memory/CPU and block urgent work.
planned_mitigation: Quarantine/scan, allowlisted MIME signatures, isolated bounded parser jobs and separate concurrency.
residual_risk: Scanner/parser bypasses remain; manual unsupported-file handling and rapid patching.
residual_rating: Unverified until control evidence and accountable-owner review

title: Secret or private payload leakage
cause: Tokens/keys or care data appear in builds, telemetry, errors or backup access.
planned_mitigation: Server secret store, encryption/TLS, redaction, environment isolation and rotation drills.
residual_risk: Privileged operator/provider access remains; minimize data and audit privileged access.
residual_rating: Unverified until control evidence and accountable-owner review

title: Duplicate and out-of-order work
cause: Replay or concurrent collection creates duplicate cases, people or actions.
planned_mitigation: Stable source/version keys, unique dispatch identities, transactional outbox and worker fencing.
residual_risk: External systems without idempotency still need reconciliation and ambiguous-match review.
residual_rating: Unverified until control evidence and accountable-owner review

title: Unknown remote write outcome
cause: A remote write succeeds while response/local receipt is lost and retry repeats it.
planned_mitigation: Persist dispatch, mark uncertainty, reconcile before resend, preserve external evidence.
residual_risk: Eventual consistency may prevent automatic proof; an owned manual exception remains.
residual_rating: Unverified until control evidence and accountable-owner review

title: Stale approval and concurrent native edit
cause: A native user or another integration changes the record after review/preflight.
planned_mitigation: Bind source/policy/fields, per-target lock, fresh preflight and native version condition where supported.
residual_risk: Without vendor compare-and-swap the race cannot be eliminated; detect/reconcile mismatches.
residual_rating: Unverified until control evidence and accountable-owner review

title: Partial cancellation and travel charges
cause: Travel cleanup is absent or happens after the native cancellation locks edits.
planned_mitigation: Approve and verify required cleanup first, then cancel/read back; track every action and communication dependency.
residual_risk: A failed later step leaves real partial changes; bookkeeper/office recovery is required.
residual_rating: Unverified until control evidence and accountable-owner review

title: Recurring/group blast radius
cause: A single write changes more occurrences/people or financial scope than approved.
planned_mitigation: Explicit occurrence list/window preview, accepted adapters and initial bounds; gate groups/series.
residual_risk: Native series expansion/state differences need per-account evidence; unsupported cases stay native.
residual_rating: Unverified until control evidence and accountable-owner review

title: Incorrect finance or payroll interpretation
cause: Missing source data becomes zero pay; estimates/units/credits are treated as actuals.
planned_mitigation: Separate units and source states, native pricing/ledger/export, approved mappings and human financial treatment.
residual_risk: The application cannot validate unprovided payroll rules or all ledger outcomes.
residual_rating: Unverified until control evidence and accountable-owner review

title: False notification success or wrong recipient
cause: Created task/sent response is mistaken for receipt or an update goes to the wrong person.
planned_mitigation: Verify recipient and track dispatch/failure/response/acknowledgement separately; native checked handoffs.
residual_risk: Some channels do not provide delivery/read proof; retain unknown states and human follow-up.
residual_rating: Unverified until control evidence and accountable-owner review

title: Incomplete collection reported as all-clear
cause: Pagination caps, wrong filters or an unavailable source hide missing evidence.
planned_mitigation: Complete-scope receipts, explicit empty/partial/stale states and cursor-aware adapters.
residual_risk: Vendor filtering/schema changes require contract monitoring and sampled native comparison.
residual_rating: Unverified until control evidence and accountable-owner review

title: Timezone cutoff or missed review
cause: DST/restarts/fortnight anchors create skipped or duplicated financial periods.
planned_mitigation: IANA zones, explicit UTC instants/calendar periods, schedule versions and bounded slot catch-up.
residual_risk: Wrong owner-approved calendar still produces wrong periods; business review remains required.
residual_rating: Unverified until control evidence and accountable-owner review

title: Wrong identity consent or signature
cause: Duplicate candidate matching or extraction updates the wrong person or accepts invalid paperwork.
planned_mitigation: Evidence-based review, explicit native IDs and conservative matching/signature checks.
residual_risk: Forgery or source errors may need human investigation; do not automate authenticity claims.
residual_rating: Unverified until control evidence and accountable-owner review

title: Worker status mistaken for access or readiness
cause: Native onboarding_status is treated as permission revocation or employment approval.
planned_mitigation: Verify role/invitation/access semantics and separate readiness/HR/payroll checks.
residual_risk: Native status and sign-in behaviour can diverge; account admin verifies actual access.
residual_rating: Unverified until control evidence and accountable-owner review

title: Over-retention or unapproved processing
cause: Care/HR data is copied broadly or sent to maps/AI/support without approved purpose.
planned_mitigation: Minimize evidence, approve processors/regions/retention/holds and default optional AI/ETA off.
residual_risk: Legal/contract interpretation and provider access remain owner/adviser responsibilities.
residual_rating: Unverified until control evidence and accountable-owner review

title: Untrusted content controls extraction or tools
cause: Email/document prompts or forged fields become authority for tool execution.
planned_mitigation: Treat content as data; bounded extraction, schema/evidence validation and no privileged tools or secrets in extraction workers.
residual_risk: Extraction may be incorrect; human approval and deterministic command checks remain required.
residual_rating: Unverified until control evidence and accountable-owner review

title: Supply chain or CI compromise
cause: Untrusted dependency/build/PR gains deploy or runtime secrets.
planned_mitigation: Pinned inputs, lockfile/SBOM/scans, protected promotion and separate least-privilege deploy identity.
residual_risk: Zero-days and platform compromise remain; patch response and artifact provenance are essential.
residual_rating: Unverified until control evidence and accountable-owner review

title: Legacy loss or unsafe migration replay
cause: Retained JSON/Redis/file history is lost or old approved/in-flight work auto-runs after cutover.
planned_mitigation: Inventory retained data, backup, hashes/counts, stop old writers and import pending work into reconciliation hold.
residual_risk: Previously pruned history cannot be reconstructed automatically; owner accepts known gaps.
residual_rating: Unverified until control evidence and accountable-owner review

title: Restore repeats remote effects
cause: Restoring DB/outbox to an earlier checkpoint loses evidence of a later native write.
planned_mitigation: Restore into write quarantine, recover external/audit evidence and reconcile native targets before re-enabling dispatch.
residual_risk: External state is not rolled back with the database; some actions require manual investigation.
residual_rating: Unverified until control evidence and accountable-owner review

title: Evidence and DB drift
cause: A file exists without metadata or a restored record points at absent/changed bytes.
planned_mitigation: Quarantine/finalization states, checksums, object versions, orphan handling and consistent restore manifests.
residual_risk: Storage outage/version retention gaps can delay evidence; keep cases blocked.
residual_rating: Unverified until control evidence and accountable-owner review

title: Outage throttling and starvation
cause: Vendor downtime or OCR backlog delays urgent work and exhausts request/spend budgets.
planned_mitigation: Bounded queues, retry budgets/jitter/Retry-After, per-account limits and separate urgent/OCR work classes.
residual_risk: Vendor outages cannot be eliminated; native/manual fallback and support coverage remain necessary.
residual_rating: Unverified until control evidence and accountable-owner review

title: Missing or misleading audit/alerts
cause: Native success or operational failure is invisible, or logs reveal confidential data.
planned_mitigation: Protected audit, source/queue/reconciliation metrics and exercised redacted alert routing.
residual_risk: App audit is not tamper-proof against all admins; separate audit access/retention and review.
residual_rating: Unverified until control evidence and accountable-owner review

title: Portal or location disclosure
cause: Demo identities, stale assignment, representative access or route data expose another person/worker home.
planned_mitigation: Verified relationship mapping, field projections, no raw worker-home sharing, no API cache and explicit optional ETA consent/freshness.
residual_risk: Device/location accuracy and representative authority require actual acceptance.
residual_rating: Unverified until control evidence and accountable-owner review

title: New owner dependency and unstaffed support
cause: Only one developer/admin understands jobs, exceptions or incident response.
planned_mitigation: Named maintainer/backup, runbooks, training, handovers, access review and funded support.
residual_risk: Staff availability and budget can still constrain response.
residual_rating: Unverified until control evidence and accountable-owner review

title: Urgent care issue waits for automation
cause: Staff rely on a scheduled alert while a safety concern or missed service needs immediate action.
planned_mitigation: Keep and rehearse the existing urgent incident/contact process and actual duty cover.
residual_risk: Human response/capacity remains essential; the system is not an emergency service.
residual_rating: Unverified until control evidence and accountable-owner review

title: Unmeasured scale or cost commitment
cause: Volumes and support are guessed, leading to overloaded or unaffordable operation.
planned_mitigation: Measure profile/baseline, test load/backlog and approve budget/thresholds before commitments.
residual_risk: Future branches and vendor pricing may change the operating envelope.
residual_rating: Unverified until control evidence and accountable-owner review

title: Rollback mistaken for native undo
cause: An old DB/code version is restored after native effects, or unsafe compensating writes are attempted.
planned_mitigation: Drain/hold uncertain work, use compatible schema and reconcile native effects with explicit review.
residual_risk: Some native effects cannot be reversed safely; manual correction can be required.
residual_rating: Unverified until control evidence and accountable-owner review

title: Environment and proxy misconfiguration
cause: Staging uses production credentials or insecure TLS/cookies/private DB ports are exposed.
planned_mitigation: Separate accounts/storage/keys, trusted ingress, egress restrictions and production fail-closed config validation.
residual_risk: Hosting/provider mistakes remain; continuously verify environment identity and access.
residual_rating: Unverified until control evidence and accountable-owner review

title: Wrong account or organization routing
cause: A valid person ID exists in another account and the wrong connector is selected.
planned_mitigation: Composite scoped identity links, explicit branch/account mappings and immutable service context.
residual_risk: Incorrect approved mapping can still route wrong; business/account acceptance is mandatory.
residual_rating: Unverified until control evidence and accountable-owner review

title: Spreadsheet formula injection
cause: Exported free-text starts spreadsheet commands when staff open a CSV.
planned_mitigation: Escape dangerous cells in approved export encoding and test target spreadsheet handling.
residual_risk: Spreadsheet behaviour varies; tested export format and training remain necessary.
residual_rating: Unverified until control evidence and accountable-owner review

title: Unverified regulatory or contract fit
cause: A plan is treated as proof of privacy/compliance or permission to use vendor data.
planned_mitigation: Qualified owner/adviser review of actual obligations, purposes, agreements, retention and processors before activation.
residual_risk: The blueprint is not a compliance certification or legal determination.
residual_rating: Unverified until control evidence and accountable-owner review
